# Hello!



### My name is Liliyah-Joy Quel-Kaina

I’m a third-year at [Chaminade University of Honolulu](https://chaminade.edu). I'm currently pursuing a dual degree in Forensic Science and Data Science Analytics & Visualization. In addition to my dual degree, I'm also minoring in Chemistry and Criminal Justice & Criminology, with a certificate in criminology and criminal justice analytics and in health informatics and analytics.
